description_ru: Весёлый монолог о человеке, который снова и снова откладывает начало диеты.
text:
My name is Dave, and I have been starting a diet for eleven years. It always begins on Monday. Unfortunately, I have never been able to find a Monday that was suitable.

Last week, I made a serious plan. I bought a book called Eat Less and Live Longer, a pair of running shoes and a basket of fresh vegetables. On Sunday evening, I stood in front of the mirror and said, "Tomorrow, everything changes."

On Monday morning, I woke up full of energy. I ate a bowl of porridge without any sugar. It tasted like wet cardboard, but I was proud. At ten o'clock, my colleague Sandra arrived with a birthday cake. "A tiny piece will not hurt," she said. I agreed, because it would be rude to refuse a birthday.

At lunchtime, I ate a salad. Then I ate Sandra's salad, because she did not like the tomatoes. In the afternoon, I went for a run. I managed to run for three minutes, and then I discovered a bakery. If the bakery had not been there, I would have run for much longer.

By the evening, I felt terrible about myself. So I decided that Monday had been a bad day to start. Tuesday was much better, since Tuesday has a friendlier name.

Tomorrow I will try again, I promise. But first, I need to finish this cake. It would be a waste to throw it away, and wasting food is bad for the planet.

focus_sounds.tip_ru: Верхние зубы касаются нижней губы, голос включён; не оглушайте звук до ф.
Кончик языка поднят к нёбу и не касается его, не вибрирует; губы чуть округлены.
Не оглушайте b, d, g, v, z в конце слова: «bed» звучит не как «bet».

questions.question: How long has Dave been starting a diet?
What did Sandra bring on Monday?
Which day does he think is friendlier?
